importExport.title: Import and export
importExport.exportHint: A CSV of all products. The cost column is only included for those who may see it.
importExport.importHint: A CSV with the columns sku, slug, brand, category (category slug), name_uk, name_en, price, compare_at_price, cost_price, weight_grams. A product is matched by sku: it is updated if it exists (an empty cell changes nothing) and created as a draft if not. Files up to 56 KB (about 250 rows).
importExport.tooBig: The file is too large: up to 56 KB (about 250 rows). Split it into parts.

orders.title: Orders
orders.cancelledRefundDue: The order is cancelled, but the money received is NOT returned. A refund is a separate step.
orders.cancelRefundWarning: Cancelling does not return the money received. Start a refund after cancelling.
orders.editHint: Set 0 to take a line off. Stock stays reserved; the totals are recalculated.
orders.refundStarted: The refund was sent. The status changes when the provider confirms.
orders.refundUnknown: The provider did not answer. The refund MAY have gone through: do not repeat it, the status updates when it is checked.
orders.refundFailed: The provider refused the refund. Nothing was returned; you can try again.
orders.refundNotSent: The refund is recorded but was not sent. Reload the card and check its state.
orders.waybillCreated: The waybill was created and the buyer is being emailed.
orders.waybillUnknown: The carrier did not answer. A waybill MAY exist: check the carrier's portal before doing anything else.
orders.waybillFailed: The carrier refused the request. Nothing was created; see the reason below and try again.
orders.waybillNeedsCheck: A waybill call did not finish. Check the carrier's portal: if a waybill exists, enter its number; if not, confirm that nothing was made. Do not create another one until then.
orders.resolveAttach: A waybill exists: enter its number
orders.exportHint: A file holds at most 10 000 orders. If it was cut, its last line says where the next part starts (use that order number as the start of the next download).
orders.resolveRefundHint: The answer of the provider is not known. Check the provider's portal and record what you found. Do not repeat the refund.

customers.exportHint: A file holds at most 10 000 customers. If it was cut, its last line says where the next part starts.
